coordinateSystem: x: head to foot; y: across; normalized playing surface

steps.title: Welcome to Focused Practice
steps.text: Welcome to the Billiards Trainer—your digital practice arena. Master shot geometry, unlock cue-ball control, and explore real billiard physics. From core fundamentals to pro runouts, step up to the table and practice on your terms.
steps.prompt: Pocket the 1-ball, then look at your cue-ball leave.

steps.title: Set Up and Aim Precisely
steps.text: Setting up a shot takes seconds. Drag any ball onto the table, or flick it into a pocket to clear the cloth. Place your cue ball, sweep to aim, and use the roller for pinpoint adjustments. The ghost ball reveals your exact line of contact before you shoot.
steps.prompt: Try the aim roller. Pocket the 8, or return a ball from the tray.

steps.title: Speed, Tip Contact, and English
steps.text: Take total command of the cue ball. Dial in your stroke speed, then tap or drag the cue-ball diagram to lock your tip contact. Add follow, dig in for draw, or apply English to shape your trajectory off the rails.
steps.prompt: Try the preset draw. Try Again, change only the speed or tip contact, and compare.

steps.title: Execute and Compare Variations
steps.text: Hit Execute Shot to unleash the physics engine. Want to see how a slight adjustment changes the leave? Reset the shot, tweak your speed or angle, and shoot again. Changing one variable at a time is the fastest way to understand how the cue ball behaves.
steps.prompt: Shoot the 4. Try Again, change one setting, and compare the leave.

steps.title: Plan and Execute Shot 2
steps.text:
Great pool is played two shots ahead. With Shot 2, plan your next ball before shooting your first. Set your landing zone and aim at your next target.

Table looking busy? Use the Show and Hide controls for Cue Ball 1 and Cue Ball 2 to hide either cue ball and its shot lines. Show them again whenever you’re ready to compare both shots.

Now press Execute Shot. The trainer fires the opener and transitions straight into shot two—ready for your next strike!
steps.prompt: Execute Shot plays the 2. Press it again to play the second plan on the 3.

steps.title: Full Racks and Runout Planning
steps.text: Step up to full-table strategy. Open Pick and Play Full Racks to load official layouts like 8-Ball, 9-Ball, or Straight Pool. Map out your patterns ball-by-ball. Add Shot 2 after each execution to plan a complete, unbroken runout from the break right through to the money ball.
steps.prompt: A 9-ball break is ready. Shoot, plan a runout, or choose another full rack.

steps.title: Undo and Reset the Layout
steps.text: Mistakes are where mastery happens. Hit Undo Last Shot to roll back time at any point in your run. Inspect what went wrong, test a new angle or tip placement, and solve the layout without having to rebuild the entire table from scratch.
steps.prompt: A real missed shot is saved. Use Undo Last Shot, adjust the aim, then shoot again.

steps.title: Guide and Explorer
steps.text: Need drills or deep technical breakdowns? Open the Guide for lessons on fundamentals and table physics. Or flip on Explorer Mode and tap any control on your screen to learn what it does. Dive in, explore the table, and start training smarter.
steps.prompt: Take the Wheel enables Explorer here. Turn Explorer off to use controls and shoot.

transition.text: The next lesson will start shortly. Tap the screen to play this layout.

completion.text: You're ready to make this table your own! Try a shot, explore the controls and settings, or open the Guide to go deeper. Turn on Explorer to discover what any control does. Your next move is yours!
